aboutUsDescription: Annedora is a small family owned business making honey and other bee products. We're passionate about our bees and we want to share our passion with you. We hope you'll enjoy our products as much as we do !
socialMedia: Follow the bees on social media!
weOfferPollinationServices: With currently tens of locations across the province, we proudly help local farmers with pollination services in order to bring more food for many families like ours.
